sources.observation: Linked dry-stone terraces step up from the boulder-strewn slope. The masonry crests follow the curve of the hill.

sources.credit: Senzeni1, see linked file for license
sources.observation: The curved main wall has five stepped courses of checkerboard recesses above a lower foreground wall. A large in-situ boulder interrupts the east retaining tier.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see linked file for license
sources.observation: The side view shows the checkerboard recesses and the lower courses bending around the boulder. Several outer returns are partly collapsed.

limitations: PMTiles identifies the hill and its approach. Terrace alignments, crest heights, recess spacing and boulder dimensions are estimated from the photographs and sampled terrain. The surrounding archaeological precinct comprises separate platforms.
